'''Derek Hawkesworth Hawkesworth Troopers''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Derek Hawkesworth]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds128.htm Hawkesworth Troopers], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027092321/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds128.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
